# Digi-Tec Performance Centre

> Digi-Tec Performance Centre is an independent workshop for European and luxury cars in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, established in 2002. It services Mercedes-Benz, Maybach, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Bugatti, Aston Martin, and Land Rover / Range Rover vehicles.

This file is a navigational summary. The linked, visible pages are the authoritative source for service scope, availability, pricing, and vehicle-specific guidance.

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 4 340 2223
- Address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Warehouse No. 11-15, Dubai, UAE
- Website: https://digitecme.com

## Key facts

- Independent Dubai workshop established in 2002
- Brand-specific diagnostic platforms listed on the relevant pages include XENTRY, ISTA+, PIWIS 3, ODIS, LDAS, SD3 and JLR systems
- Estimates can specify genuine, OE-supplier or suitable customer-approved alternative parts, depending on the repair and owner preference
- Inspection findings and the proposed scope are explained before approved repair work begins
